title: How Cost-Effective Is LEEP's Malawi Program?
note: Built from the totals stated on the page ($590,000 discounted spending; 8,000 DALYs and 35,000 DALY-equivalents of earnings over 20 years; $13.7 per DALY-equivalent, LEEP's median $14). The model itself was in Causal and the linked documentation needs a Google sign-in (both checked 2026-11-15); the page's 'CEA model sheet' link is GiveWell's 2021 top-charity CEA, used only for LEEP's GiveDirectly comparison.

title: LEEP cost-effectiveness analysis - Malawi (first version)
status: not imported: superseded by LEEP's January 2022 update of the same Malawi model ($12 per DALY-equivalent before, $14 after); its documentation is cited by the imported model for the method

title: How cost-effective are LEEP's paint programs?
note: Built from the totals stated on the page (145,000 health DALYs and 756,000 DALY-equivalents of earnings, $4.49 per DALY-equivalent, 46.6 million children, 2021 to 2100) with the inputs from the model documentation (this link, public) and the sensitivity analysis sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PeNSD1pqSQWF2afvQM0dIj1C-UcRHh4XGU_OmmjstZ4/edit, public). The Causal model itself no longer shows (checked 2026-11-15); the cost is the one LEEP's $4.49 and 901,000 imply (it states about $4 million).
